pals.definition:
n a close friend who accompanies his buddies in their activities
v become friends; act friendly towards
pals.translation: abbr. 高级生命支持（Pediatric Advanced Life Support）；位置测定系统（Positioning and Location System）

palsa.translation: n. [地](由冰川推起或在冰川附近形成的高3至6米的)穹形泥炭丘

palsgrave.definition: n (Middle Ages) the lord of a palatinate who exercised sovereign powers over his lands

palsgravine.definition: n. The consort or widow of a palsgrave.
palsgravine.translation: n. [史]巴拉丁伯爵的夫人(或遗孀)

palship.translation: n. <美口> 好友关系,伙伴关系,友谊

palsied.definition: s. affected with palsy or uncontrollable tremor
palsied.translation: a. 中风的, 瘫痪的, 颤抖的

palsies.translation: n. 瘫痪( palsy的名词复数 )

palstage.translation: 古地理阶段; 古地理时期

palstave.definition:
n. A peculiar bronze adz, used in prehistoric Europe about
   the middle of the bronze age.

palsy.definition:
n. a condition marked by uncontrollable tremor
v. affect with palsy
palsy.translation:
n. 中风, 麻痹, (不由自主的)颤动, 麻痹状态
vt. 麻痹, 使瘫痪

palsy-walsy.definition: s (used colloquially) having the relationship of friends or pals

palsying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Palsy
palsying.translation: v. 瘫痪( palsy的现在分词 )

palsywalsy.translation:
n. [美俚]伙伴, 好朋友
a. 要好的, 亲密的
